subject: Another 'Failed to create the shared library' error

messages.author: 610d50172ecb2187
messages.subject: Another 'Failed to create the shared library' error
parts:
System:
Windows 10
R 3.6.1
R Studio 1.1.423 
Rtools 3.5

Analysis:
library(FSAdata)
data(PSalmonAK)
str(PSalmonAK)
head(PSalmonAK)
S<-PSalmonAK$escapement[-c(1,2,33,34)]
R<-PSalmonAK$return[-c(1,2,33,34)
]
library(nimble)
BHCode <- nimbleCode({
  for (t in 1:Years) {
    logR[t] ~ dnorm(loga+log(S[t])-(1+b*S[t]), sd = sigma);
  }
  a<-exp(loga)
  loga ~ dunif(0, 15)
  b ~ dbeta(1,1)
  sigma ~ dunif(0, 100)
})

BHConstants <- list(Years=30)
BHData<-list(logR=log(R),S=S)
BHInits <- list(loga = 0.5, b = 0.5,sigma = 50)
BHmod<- nimbleModel(code = BHCode, name = "BH", constants = BHConstants,
                    data = BHData, inits = BHInits)

mcmc.out <- nimbleMCMC(code = BHCode, constants = BHConstants,
                       data = BHData, inits = BHInits,
                       nchains = 2, niter = 10000,
                       summary = TRUE, WAIC = FALSE,
                       monitors = c('a','b','sigma'))

Output:
defining model...
building model...
setting data and initial values...
running calculate on model (any error reports that follow may simply reflect missing values in model variables) ...
checking model sizes and dimensions...
checking model calculations...
model building finished.
compiling... this may take a minute. On some systems there may be some compiler warnings that can be safely ignored.
c:/Rtools/mingw_64/bin/g++  -I"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-36~1.1/include" -DNDEBUG -DR_NO_REMAP -I"\\Kalawatseti/home/falcym/docs/R/win-library/3.6/nimble/include" -I"" -I"" -DEIGEN_MPL2_ONLY=1 -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-ignored-attributes -Wno-deprecated-declarations         -O2 -Wall  -mtune=generic -c dynamicRegistrations_07_22_13_39_51.cpp -o dynamicRegistrations_07_22_13_39_51.o
dynamicRegistrations_07_22_13_39_51.cpp:1:41: fatal error: nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h: No such file or directory
 #include <nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h>
                                         ^
compilation terminated.
make: *** [C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-36~1.1/etc/x64/Makeconf:215: dynamicRegistrations_07_22_13_39_51.o] Error 1


Notes:
  • I checked the box to have Rtools added to PATH.
  • Works fine on a different computer.
  • I've updated and reinstalled R, Rtoos, Rstudio and then reloaded NIMBLE.
Gratitude
  • A lot

messages.author: 2226e6c311219eb7
messages.subject: Re: Another 'Failed to create the shared library' error
parts:
This looks like an issue that arose last week on the R bug tracker,
dealing with UNC (Universal Naming Convention) paths and R and the
MINGW
compiler.
It is the \\Kalawatseti/home/... in the compilation line, preceded by
the -I" to indicate where to find the header files that it fails to
find.

In the NIMBLE code, the paths handed to the compilation step are
(probably - can't recall off hand) found via find.package() or
system.file()
and then these need to be transformed via normalizePath().

D.

messages.subject: Re: Another 'Failed to create the shared library' error
parts:
Thanks Duncan.

For those interested, I think this must be the relevant bug on R bug tracker: https://bugs.r-project.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=17582

It looks like the issue arises when working on a non-local drive.  m falcy, is that your situation?

In a future nimble release, we could take care of ensuring that normalizePath is used.

For m falcy, a short-term workaround could be to install nimble on a local drive using the lib argument to install.packages() and then load it from that location using the lib.loc argument to library().  Does that work?

-Perry

messages.author: 610d50172ecb2187
messages.subject: Re: Another 'Failed to create the shared library' error
parts:
Duncan and Perry-

You fixed it!

I am indeed using a non-local drive.  I have not had this problem on two different machines working on their respective local drives.

I installed nimble onto my local C:, removed all loaded packages, then reloaded nimble with the lib.loc argument to library() as advised by Perry. At first I obtained the same error.  Upon inspection of the detailed report using 'nimbleOptions(showCompilerOutput = TRUE)' I noticed that R was still looking for nimble in my non-local drive (\\Kalawatseti/home):

c:/Rtools/mingw_64/bin/g++  -I"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-36~1.1/include" -DNDEBUG -DR_NO_REMAP -I"\\Kalawatseti/home/falcym/docs/R/win-library/3.6/nimble/include" -I"" -I"" -DEIGEN_MPL2_ONLY=1 -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-ignored-attributes -Wno-deprecated-declarations         -O2 -Wall  -mtune=generic -c dynamicRegistrations_07_23_08_47_49.cpp -o dynamicRegistrations_07_23_08_47_49.o
dynamicRegistrations_07_23_08_47_49.cpp:1:41: fatal error: nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h: No such file or directory
 #include <nimble/dynamicRegistrations.h>
                                         ^
compilation terminated.
make: *** [C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-36~1.1/etc/x64/Makeconf:215: dynamicRegistrations_07_23_08_47_49.o] Error 1
Error: Failed to create the shared library.


So just manually deleted the initial nimble download in my non-local drive and then everything worked.

Thanks a bunch!
